question: Who is the author of the book ‘Train to Pakistan’?
solution:
The correct answer is Khushwant Singh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• Train to Pakistan, first published in 1956, is a classic of modern Indian fiction. It is one of the best works by Khushwant Singh.
 
• It is short but a powerful story about the Partition of India in 1947.
 
• The whole country was shaken by the woes of partition & the riots between the Sikhs and Muslims. 
 
• *Khushwant Singh boldly highlights these tragedies faced by the communities by means of the fictional town of Mano Majra.*
 
• Khushwant Singh's book ‘A History of the Sikhs’ is regarded *as the most authoritative work on Sikh history. *
 
• Khushwant Singh was an Indian novelist, journalist, and lawyer.
 
• He was a man of many talents and served the Indian legal system, Indian journalism, and literature all with equal passion and hard work.
 
• He was awarded a lot of accolad
